meta.title: Magpie real route
meta.description: Show the real upstream model behind a magpie routing group directly below the composer. The dock line refreshes every 15 seconds and on click; it reads the package Host half's same-origin route /plugins/magpie-route/route, so the browser never calls the gateway directly. Read-only: it sends no model request and does not change routing; the magpie gateway must be running. In-flight requests without usage are counted but not reported as a route. The dock shows the latest settled request across DSH sessions because DSH does not send X-Magpie-Session. The default gateway is http://127.0.0.1:3425; baseURL, agent, and limit are edited in the bundle's cordis.patch.yml and take effect after a reload/restart (no UI config form). This plugin adds no command and no agent tool.
